title: PeerChat: Peer-to-Peer Messaging Library
text: UDP peer--peer messaging library backed C networking core. Provides R Python bindings creating sockets, discovering peers via central synchronization server written C, exchanging messages directly clients without relaying server. leverages custom made data protocol.

title: PeerChat: Peer-to-Peer Messaging Library
text: Client registers server via username password Client pings server known peers connection persist message someone, request address server via peer_get_user() Server validates credentials introduces peers Peers communicate directly (relay server)

title: PeerChat: Peer-to-Peer Messaging Library
code: library(PeerChat)  # Connect to the server peer_connect("my_username", "my_password")  # Discover a peer peer_get_user("friend", "friends_password")  # Send a message peer_send_message("friend", "Hello!")  # Receive incoming packets peer_receive(1000)  # Disconnect peer_disconnect()
